newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yip's Pota offers 50 mln shrs at HK$1.00 each.
newsitem.headline: Yip's Pota offers 50 mln shrs at HK$1.00 each.

text.p: Souvenir maker Yip's Pota International Co Ltd plans to offer 50 million shares at HK$1.00 per share in an initial public offer (IPO) in Hong Kong, the company said on Monday.
The issue price represents a prospective price-earnings ratio of five times on a weighted average and 6.8 times on a proforma fully diluted basis, Yip's said.
Market capitalisation of the company will be HK$200 million.
The IPO will run from January 7-10, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on January 20.
Yip's forecast earnings to be not less than HK$28 million for the year ended December 31, 1996. This compared with a net profit of HK$21 million in 1995 on turnover of HK$214 million.

About HK$40 million of the net proceeds will be used to buy a plant and machinery, to inject further capital into a factory in Dongguan in Guangdong province, and to fund construction of a plant to house a centralised silk-screening operation and warehouse, Yip's said.
The remaining balance will be used to repay borrowings and as general working capital, it said.
In 1995, the company derived 33 percent of its sales revenue in Europe, 26 percent in North America, 15 percent in South America and 11 percent in Japan.
Yip's makes promotional items in PVC leather.
DBS Asia Capital Ltd is the sponsor of the issue.
